name: Minimal Non-Spread Ample Classes
definition: The family of finite non-spread ample classes all of whose proper pc-minors are spread ample, modulo coordinate permutations, coordinate flips, and deletion of constant coordinates.
recognition: A certificate consists of a failure of diameter optimality for the class and spread certificates for every immediate proper projection and conditioning. An intrinsic complete enumeration is not currently known.
comments: This predicate family gives the formal complete basis. Explicit members are classified through five coordinates in the source manuscript, with four further six-coordinate examples.
